verses.en: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Yahoshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
verses.am: And when they had set the people, {even} all the host that {was} on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley. {liers...: Heb. lying in wait}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Yisra'el to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw {it}, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that {there were} liers in ambush against him behind the city.

verses.en: And Yahoshua and all Yisra'el made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
verses.am: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

verses.en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Yahoshua, and were drawn away from the city.
verses.am: And all the people that {were} in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

verses.en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Yisra'el: and they left the city open, and pursued after Yisra'el.
verses.am: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Yahoshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Yahoshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
verses.am: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that {is} in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that {he had} in his hand toward the city.

verses.en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
verses.am: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

verses.en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
verses.am: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers. {power: Heb. hand}

verses.en: And when Yahoshua and all Yisra'el saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
verses.am: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

verses.en: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Yisra'el, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
verses.am: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

verses.en: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Yahoshua.
verses.am: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Yisra'el had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Yisra'elites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.en: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
verses.am: And {so} it was, {that} all that fell that day, both of men and women, {were} twelve thousand, {even} all the men of Ai.

verses.en: For Yahoshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.am: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Yisra'el took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of YAHUAH which he commanded Yahoshua.
verses.am: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

verses.en: And Yahoshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
verses.am: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, {even} a desolation unto this day.

verses.en: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Yahoshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.
verses.am: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, {that remaineth} unto this day.

verses.en: Then Yahoshua built an altar unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el in mount Ebal,
verses.am: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

verses.en: As Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH commanded the children of Yisra'el, as it is written in the book of the law of Mosheh, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto YAHUAH, and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.am: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up {any} iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Mosheh, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

verses.en: And all Yisra'el, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of YAHUAH, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

verses.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
verses.am: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

verses.en: There was not a word of all that Mosheh commanded, which Yahoshua read not before all the congregation of Yisra'el, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
verses.am: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them. {were...: Heb. walked}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
verses.am: And it came to pass, when all the kings which {were} on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard {thereof};

verses.en: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Yahoshua and with Yisra'el, with one accord.
verses.am: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord. {accord: Heb. mouth}

verses.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Yahoshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
verses.am: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

verses.en: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
verses.am: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

verses.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
verses.am: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry {and} mouldy.

verses.en: And they went to Yahoshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Yisra'el, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
verses.am: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

verses.en: And the men of Yisra'el said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
verses.am: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

verses.en: And they said unto Yahoshua, We are thy servants. And Yahoshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
verses.am: And they said unto Joshua, We {are} thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who {are} ye? and from whence come ye?

verses.en: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Mitsrayim,
verses.am: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

verses.en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
verses.am: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that {were} beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which {was} at Ashtaroth.

verses.en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
verses.am: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We {are} your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us. {with you: Heb. in your hand}

verses.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
verses.am: This our bread we took hot {for} our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

verses.en: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
verses.am: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, {were} new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

verses.en: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not {counsel} at the mouth of the LORD. {the men...: or, they received the men by reason of their victuals}

verses.en: And Yahoshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
verses.am: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
verses.am: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they {were} their neighbours, and {that} they dwelt among them.

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.
verses.am: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities {were} Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by YAHUAH of Yisra'el. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.am: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

verses.en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by YAHUAH of Yisra'el: now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.am: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

verses.en: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
verses.am: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

verses.en: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
verses.am: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

verses.en: And Yahoshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
verses.am: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We {are} very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

verses.en: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my YAHUAH.
verses.am: Now therefore ye {are} cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God. {none...: Heb. not be cut off from you}

verses.en: And they answered Yahoshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that YAHUAH thy YAHUAH commanded his servant Mosheh to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.am: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

verses.en: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
verses.am: And now, behold, we {are} in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

verses.en: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Yisra'el, that they slew them not.
verses.am: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

verses.en: And Yahoshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of YAHUAH, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.am: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose. {made: Heb. gave, or, delivered to be}

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedek king of Yerushalayim had heard how Yahoshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Yisra'el, and were among them;
verses.am: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

verses.en: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
verses.am: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon {was} a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it {was} greater than Ai, and all the men thereof {were} mighty. {royal...: Heb. cities of the kingdom}

verses.en: Wherefore Adonizedek king of Yerushalayim sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.am: Wherefore Adonizedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.en: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Yahoshua and with the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

verses.en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Yerushalayim, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
verses.am: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

verses.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Yahoshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
verses.am: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

verses.en: So Yahoshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
verses.am: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Yahoshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
verses.am: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

verses.en: Yahoshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
verses.am: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, {and} went up from Gilgal all night.

verses.en: And YAHUAH discomfited them before Yisra'el, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
verses.am: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Yisra'el, and were in the going down to Bethhoron, that YAHUAH cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Yisra'el slew with the sword.
verses.am: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, {and} were in the going down to Bethhoron, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: {they were} more which died with hailstones than {they} whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

verses.en: Then spake Yahoshua to YAHUAH in the day when YAHUAH delivered up the Amorites before the children of Yisra'el, and he said in the sight of Yisra'el, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
verses.am: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon. {stand...: Heb. be silent}

verses.en: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verses.am: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. {Is} not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day. {Jasher: or, the upright?}

verses.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that YAHUAH hearkened unto the voice of a man: for YAHUAH fought for Yisra'el.
verses.am: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

verses.en: And Yahoshua returned, and all Yisra'el with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.am: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.en: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.am: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.en: And it was told Yahoshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.am: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.en: And Yahoshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
verses.am: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

verses.en: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath delivered them into your hand.
verses.am: And stay ye not, {but} pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand. {smite...: Heb. cut off the tail}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Yahoshua and the children of Yisra'el had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest {which} remained of them entered into fenced cities.

verses.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Yahoshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

verses.en: Then said Yahoshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.am: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

verses.am: But {that} it {may be} a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.

verses.en: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of YAHUAH, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
verses.am: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should {so} say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say {again}, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it {is} a witness between us and you.

verses.en: YAHUAH forbid that we should rebel against YAHUAH, and turn this day from following YAHUAH, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of YAHUAH our YAHUAH that is before his tabernacle.
verses.am: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that {is} before his tabernacle.

verses.en: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Yisra'el which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
verses.am: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which {were} with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them. {pleased...: Heb. was good in their eyes}

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that YAHUAH is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against YAHUAH: now ye have delivered the children of Yisra'el out of the hand of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD {is} among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD. {now: Heb. then}

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Yisra'el, and brought them word again.
verses.am: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

verses.en: And the thing pleased the children of Yisra'el; and the children of Yisra'el blessed YAHUAH, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
verses.am: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

verses.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that YAHUAH is YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar {Ed}: for it {shall be} a witness between us that the LORD {is} God. {Ed: that is, A witness}

verses.en: And it came to pass a long time after that YAHUAH had given rest unto Yisra'el from all their enemies round about, that Yahoshua waxed old and stricken in age.
verses.am: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old {and} stricken in age. {stricken...: Heb. come into days}

verses.en: And Yahoshua called for all Yisra'el, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
verses.am: And Joshua called for all Israel, {and} for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old {and} stricken in age:

verses.en: And ye have seen all that YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath done unto all these nations because of you; for YAHUAH your YAHUAH is he that hath fought for you.
verses.am: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God {is} he that hath fought for you.

verses.en: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
verses.am: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward. {westward: Heb. at the sunset}

verses.en: And YAHUAH your YAHUAH, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath promised unto you.
verses.am: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

verses.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Mosheh, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
verses.am: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom {to} the right hand or {to} the left;

verses.en: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their elohim, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
verses.am: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear {by them}, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

verses.en: But cleave unto YAHUAH your YAHUAH, as ye have done unto this day.
verses.am: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day. {But cleave...: or, For if ye will cleave, etc}

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
verses.am: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but {as for} you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day. {For the LORD...: or, Then the LORD will drive}

verses.en: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for YAHUAH your YAHUAH, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
verses.am: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he {it is} that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

verses.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love YAHUAH your YAHUAH.
verses.am: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God. {yourselves: Heb. your souls}

verses.en: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
verses.am: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, {even} these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

verses.en: Know for a certainty that YAHUAH your YAHUAH will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath given you.
verses.am: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out {any of} these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

verses.en: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which YAHUAH your YAHUAH spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
verses.am: And, behold, this day I {am} going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, {and} not one thing hath failed thereof.

verses.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which YAHUAH your YAHUAH promised you; so shall YAHUAH bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath given you.
verses.am: Therefore it shall come to pass, {that} as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

verses.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of YAHUAH your YAHUAH, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other elohim, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of YAHUAH be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
verses.am: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

verses.en: And Yahoshua gathered all the tribes of Yisra'el to Shechem, and called for the elders of Yisra'el, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

verses.en: And Yahoshua said unto all the people, Thus saith YAHUAH of Yisra'el, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other elohim.
verses.am: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, {even} Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

verses.en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Yitschaq.
verses.am: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

verses.en: And I gave unto Yitschaq Ya'aqob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Ya'aqob and his children went down into Mitsrayim.
verses.am: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

verses.en: I sent Mosheh also and Aaron, and I plagued Mitsrayim, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.am: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

verses.en: And I brought your fathers out of Mitsrayim: and ye came unto the sea; and the Mitsrim pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
verses.am: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

verses.en: And when they cried unto YAHUAH, he put darkness between you and the Mitsrim, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Mitsrayim: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
verses.am: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

verses.en: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.am: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

verses.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Yisra'el, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
verses.am: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

verses.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.am: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

verses.en: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.am: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

verses.en: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
verses.am: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, {even} the two kings of the Amorites; {but} not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

verses.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
verses.am: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

verses.en: Now therefore fear YAHUAH, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the elohim which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Mitsrayim; and serve ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.

verses.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve YAHUAH, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the elohim which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the elohim of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve YAHUAH.
verses.am: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that {were} on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

verses.en: And the people answered and said, YAHUAH forbid that we should forsake YAHUAH, to serve other elohim;
verses.am: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

verses.en: For YAHUAH our YAHUAH, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Mitsrayim, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
verses.am: For the LORD our God, he {it is} that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

verses.en: And YAHUAH drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve YAHUAH; for he is our YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: {therefore} will we also serve the LORD; for he {is} our God.

verses.en: And Yahoshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve YAHUAH: for he is an holy YAHUAH; he is a jealous YAHUAH; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
verses.am: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he {is} an holy God; he {is} a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins. {holy God: Heb. holy Gods}

verses.en: If ye forsake YAHUAH, and serve strange elohim, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
verses.am: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

verses.en: And the people said unto Yahoshua, Nay; but we will serve YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.

verses.en: And Yahoshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you YAHUAH, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
verses.am: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye {are} witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, {We are} witnesses.

verses.en: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange elohim which are among you, and incline your heart unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now therefore put away, {said he}, the strange gods which {are} among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.en: And the people said unto Yahoshua, YAHUAH our YAHUAH will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
verses.am: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

verses.en: So Yahoshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.am: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

verses.en: And Yahoshua wrote these words in the book of the law of YAHUAH, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that {was} by the sanctuary of the LORD.

verses.en: And Yahoshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of YAHUAH which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

verses.en: So Yahoshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
verses.am: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that Yahoshua the son of Nun, the servant of YAHUAH, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.am: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, {being} an hundred and ten years old.

verses.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
verses.am: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which {is} in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

verses.en: And Yisra'el served YAHUAH all the days of Yahoshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Yahoshua, and which had known all the works of YAHUAH, that he had done for Yisra'el.
verses.am: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel. {overlived...: Heb. prolonged their days after Joshua}

verses.en: And the bones of Yoseph, which the children of Yisra'el brought up out of Mitsrayim, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Ya'aqob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Yoseph.
verses.am: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph. {pieces...: or, lambs}

verses.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
verses.am: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill {that pertained to} Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
